Cennakeśava
--C. Nyāyamañjarī on Pramāṇalakṣaṇaṭīkā of Jayatīrtha. MD. 17087. See Keśavācārya, NCC. V. p.. 71-72.

Cennaṃbhaṭṭa
--C. Vyākhyā on Rāmasaundaryalaharī of Sārvabhauma Mahākavi.
Pt.. Ramabhavanam Ser. 3. Vāṇī Vilās Press, Srirangam.
See IO. Pt.. Books 1938, p.. 636. 2101.

Cennaṃbhaṭṭaniruktivyākriyā
C. on Tarkabhāṣā (?) by Sudarśanaguru. Mysore III. p. 11. [Page074-a.

Cennaveṅkaṭasūri
father of Nṛsim3habhāgavata (a. of Vṛttaratnārṇava, Adyar D. VI. 780). See Veṅkaṭasūri.

Cennasadāśivayogin
alias Sadāśivayoginātha.
--Śivayogapradīpikā. TD. 8201.
See Sadāśivayoginātha.

Cennibhaṭṭa,_ºbhaṭṭīya
See below Cennu Bhaṭṭa, Cennubhaṭṭīya.

Cennubhaṭṭa(canniº,_Cinnaº)
of Andhra; son of Sahajasarvajña Viṣṇubhaṭṭopādhyāya (a. of C.. on Pañcapādikāvivaraṇa, ref. to in Sarvadarśanasaṅgraha, BORI. edn. p. 458) an. younger brother of Sarvajña; an. teacher of Rāmeśvara (who completed his C. on Tārkikarakṣāsārasaṅgraha) an. Viṣṇu (a. of Cennubhaṭṭīyaniruktivivṛti, MT. 3440 (b); patronized by King Harihara of Vijayanagar (latter half of 14th Cent.).
--C. Vivaraṇa on Varadarāja's Tārkikarakṣāsārasaṅgraha (MT. 2923. TCD. 596). completed by his pupil Rāmeśvara.
--C. Prakāśikā called Cennubhaṭṭīya on Keśavamiśra's Tarkabhāṣā. IO. 5776.
Pt.. Bomb. Skt. Pkt. Ser. 84. 1937.
--Sarvadarśanasaṅgraha (Ref. to by a. in his Vivaraṇa on Tārkikarakṣā) generally attributed to Mādhavācārya. On the authorship of this work, see A. Thakur, Adyar Library Bulletin 25. p.. 524-38. [Page074-b]

Cennubhaṭṭīya(cennaº,_Cinnaº)
by Cennubhaṭṭa, unspecified but mostly C. on Tarkabhāṣā. Bikaner 6000. Oppert II. 2927. 4585. 7370. TA. 2105. Taylor II. 344.

Cennubhaṭṭīyakārikā
ny. by Cennubhaṭṭa. MT. 2156 (b) (with C.).
--C. Ṭippaṇi. MT. 1465 (inc.).
--C. Vivṛti by Pālaṅgi Brahma Yajvan. MT. 2156 (b).

Cennubhaṭṭīyaniruktivivṛti
C.. on Cennubhaṭṭa's C. on Tarkabhāṣā. by Viṣṇubhaṭṭa, pupil of Cennubhaṭṭa.
Maccāṭ 40 (a..). MT. 3440 (b). Mysore I. p. 372 (Vyākhyā). Trav. Uni. C. 1725. T. 970. 120B (inc.). 896 (inc.). 10669C (inc.).
